title: JSFL: implement doc.align() for selection alignment
description:
doc.align() is a no-op stub in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts. Implement it using the existing updateDisplayObject() pattern already used by moveSelectionBy().

Flash 8 JSFL signature: doc.align(alignMode: string, bUseDocumentBounds: boolean)
Supported alignModes: 'left edge', 'right edge', 'top edge', 'bottom edge', 'center vertical', 'center horizontal', 'distribute widths', 'distribute heights'

Implementation approach:
1. Get selected objects (same pattern as moveSelectionBy)
2. Compute union bounds of all selected objects (implement a helper if needed, or compute inline)
3. For edge alignment (left/right/top/bottom): if bUseDocumentBounds=true, align to stage edges (0, docWidth, 0, docHeight); otherwise align to the leftmost/rightmost/topmost/bottommost edge of the selection
4. For center alignment: center relative to selection union or stage
5. For distribute: space objects evenly between the outermost objects
6. Apply updateDisplayObject for each affected object

Also implement doc.space() if its stub is nearby: same file. Flash 8 doc.space() accepts 'space evenly vertically' or 'space evenly horizontally'.

Run tests after (must stay at 612). NOTE: must be done AFTER task 1044 since both touch runtime.ts.
